resources.string: Manage the passkeys saved in this Google account.
These labels change only in Password Manager. They do not change your account at the website.
Older passkey replaced by another saved passkey

Delete these %1$d saved passkeys from this Google account? Deleting an active passkey also removes its older saved versions shown below. Your account at the website stays open; you may need another way to sign in.
A saved passkey change still needs review. Refresh checks what Google currently stores and does not send the change again.
A passkey changed since it was selected. Close the pending operation and review the latest saved passkeys before making another change.

Review the exact pending passkeys below. An earlier request may already have reached Google and may still finish. Continuing retains that attempt and starts a new attempt only for the pending records that still match a fresh server snapshot. Confirmed records are not sent again.

This closes the pending operation and retains its recovery record. Confirmed changes stay applied. An earlier request may already have reached Google and may still finish; closing does not undo or cancel it.
The Google vault changed. Changes from the previous vault cannot be replayed. Close its pending operation to retain the recovery record, then refresh this vault.
A passkey creation has an unresolved outcome. Refresh may confirm it, or you can explicitly close that attempt before editing saved passkeys.
The passkey operation could not be confirmed. Refresh to review the saved state before continuing.
